decision.title: Continuous integration
decision.summary: Continuous integration in .github/workflows/ci.yml builds on Linux with Clang and GCC, macOS Clang, Windows MSVC (build only) and WASI under Node.js 22, with lints on Linux Clang only.

body.p: (task 0.4). .github/workflows/ci.yml: Linux Clang (debug, plus lints) and GCC (debug-gcc), macOS Clang (debug), Windows MSVC (msvc, build only), WASI (wasm, tests under Node.js 22). Lints run on Linux Clang only.
